summary: Disc Medicine filed an 8-K disclosing a routine amendment to its existing loan agreement with Hercules Capital. The amendment extends draw periods for Tranche 1-C and introduces a new Tranche 1-D, while also modifying cash covenants. This is a standard financing arrangement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event is involved. The filing merely reflects ongoing credit facility management.
